result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout problem where content is being covered by the bottom navigation, and one minor clipping issue in the horizontal restaurant row.

issues.description: The second card under "Popular right now" is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, so the restaurant image/content is clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so the last visible card sits fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in the "Fastest near you" carousel is cut off at the edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal list clearly supports scrolling or adjust card spacing so partially hidden items are not mistaken for a rendering issue.
